# web_manifest — M-STACK.1 config-evidence fixture

No source files: the point is a project whose frontend the IR cannot see.
The stack index must still name next / react / vitest / vite from the
manifest and the config file, every one of them labelled `config` so a
reader knows no code was parsed for it. `left-pad` is declared and
deliberately unclassifiable — a dependency no table knows is NOT invented
into the spec from a manifest line alone.
